title: Cluj Napoca celebrate Cup title
description: Oradea - Cluj Napoca 84-85 Cluj Napoca celebrated Romanian Cup title. They nipped Oradea in the Final tonight. The guests trailed by 4 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 3-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 85-84, following a late free throw from Daron Russell. Cluj Napoca outrebounded Oradea 42-30 including a 17-5 advantage in offensive rebounds. 26 personal fouls committed by Oradea helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international point guard Daron Russell (180-1998, college: Maryland) who helped to win the game recording 21 points and 5 assists. Serbian center Dusan Miletic (213-1998) contributed with 18 points and 9 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field) for the winners. title: Cluj Napoca nip Oradea to defend Liga Nationala title
description: FINALOradea - Cluj Napoca 67-68 Cluj Napoca earned the fifth straight Liga Nationala title. They overcame Oradea in the decisive fifth game of the chamionship series to repeat as champions. The guests trailed by 2 points after three quarters before their 19-16 charge, which allowed them to win the game. The best player for the winners was American point guard Zavier Simpson (183-1997, college: Michigan) who scored 26 points. His fellow American import center Zachary Hankins (211-1996, college: Xavier, agency: Octagon Europe) chipped in 8 points and 8 rebounds. Cluj Napoca's coach Mihai Silvasan used a ten-player rotation in such tough game. Lithuanian Donatas Tarolis (205-1994) produced a double-double by scoring 18 points, 12 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals and American-Cambodian guard Sayeed Pridgett (196-1998, college: Montana, agency: Diamond Sports) added 12 points and 6 rebounds…
imageCaption: Cluj Napoca nip Oradea to defend Liga Nationala title (Photo: Cluj Napoca)

title: Cluj Napoca repeat as Liga Nationala champions
description: Cluj Napoca - Oradea 97-89 Cluj Napoca earned the fourth straight Liga Nationala title. They outscored Oradea in the fifth game of the Finals to defend their title. Cluj Napoca led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They made 24-of-31 free shots (77.4 percent) during the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Oradea helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was American point guard Bryce Jones (183-1994, college: Murray St.) who scored 22 points. The former international point guard Patrick Richard (193-1990, college: McNeese St., agency: Inception Sports) chipped in 10 points, 5 rebounds and 8 assists. Jones is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. Five Cluj Napoca players scored in double figures. The former…
imageCaption: Cluj Napoca repeat as Liga Nationala champions (Photo: facebook)

title: U-BT Cluj Napoca repeat as Liga Nationala champions
description: U-BT Cluj Napoca - Oradea 70-59 U-BT Cluj Napoca defended the Liga Nationala title. They beat Oradea at home court to win the Finals 4-2. Five players scored in double digits for the champions. Nemanja Gordic (193-G-1988) finished with 14 points and 6 assists in the win. Cluj Napoca grabbed a 20-15 lead after ten minutes. But Oradea erased the deficit in the second term to tie things up at 35. Cluj Napoca went on a 16-10 run in the third term to take a 6-point lead. They held Oradea to just 14 points in the fourth stanza and rallied to the win. Karel Guzman (188-SG-1995, agency: Pro Sports) provided 11 points in the victory. Nikola Markovic (208-F/C-1989) answered with 13 points for Oradea.
imageCaption: U-BT Cluj Napoca repeat as Liga Nationala champions

title: Cluj Napoca celebrate Liga Nationala title
description: Voluntari - Cluj Napoca 74-85 Cluj Napoca clinched Liga Nationala title. They beat Voluntari in Game 4 of the Finals to capture the trophy. The guests trailed by 3 points after three quarters before their 27-13 charge, which allowed them to win the game. 27 personal fouls committed by Voluntari helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international swingman Patrick Richard (196-1990, college: McNeese St., agency: Inception Sports) who helped to win the game recording 19 points and American center Dustin Hogue (198-1992, college: Iowa St.) who added 15 points and 5 rebounds during the contest. Four Cluj Napoca players scored in double figures. title: Cluj Napoca earn Liga Nationala title
description: Cluj Napoca - Oradea 86-67 Cluj Napoca celebrated Liga Nationala title. They topped Oradea in the decider to lift the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Cluj Napoca. Oradea managed to win second period 19-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 16-of-20 free shots (80.0 percent) during the game. The best player for the winners was Lithuanian forward Donatas Tarolis (207-94) who scored 24 points and 7 rebounds (on 8-of-9 shooting from the field). Bosnian-Croatian center Andrija Stipanovic (208-86, agency: BeoBasket) chipped in 13 points and 9 rebounds. Four Cluj Napoca players scored in double figures. American guard Aaron Broussard (196-90, college: Seattle) produced 18 points and 6 rebounds and the other American import guard Stephen Holt (193-91, college: St.Mary's, CA) added 7 points respectively for the guests.
